objective: Make CPVS derivation enforce its documented finite non-zero magnitude requirement in the final two-band membership intersection.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Scientific Validation run 38005546758 showed 741787 candidate IDs versus 730184 published IDs.
The derivation computed per-band valid-magnitude sets but intersected raw SNR-qualified sets, so its implementation did not enforce the predicate recorded in the evidence manifest.
Independent diagnostics that already filter finite non-zero magnitudes still produce 741785 candidates; this correction alone is not expected to resolve the full discrepancy.

baseline.status: derive_730k intersected raw SNR-qualified IDs and did not apply the valid-magnitude sets, despite documenting finite non-zero magnitudes as part of the predicate.

expected_improvement: Intersect SNR-qualified membership with finite non-zero magnitude membership in both bands.
Report diagnostic counts with accurate magnitude-quality semantics rather than calling them flag-quality counts.
Add a regression test where a zero-magnitude row passes the SNR threshold but must not enter the final two-band selection.

correctness.before: Final selection used raw SNR IDs; invalid-magnitude rows could enter the output.
correctness.after: Final selection is the intersection of SNR-qualified IDs and finite non-zero magnitude IDs in both bands.

evidence: Added a focused regression test; CI and source-backed CPVS audit are pending.

root_causes: The derivation calculated valid_magnitude but never intersected it into the final selected ID set.

findings: Documented scientific selection predicates must be enforced in the final membership set, not only calculated for diagnostics.
This code correction is necessary but insufficient: source-backed diagnostics already show a remaining ~11.6k membership discrepancy after finite-magnitude filtering.

open_blockers: Re-run source-backed membership audit and investigate the remaining mismatch without hardcoding IDs.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not claim exact CPVS reproduction until the independent membership audit passes.
Never hardcode discrepant IDs or tune thresholds only to match a target count.
Keep frozen v0.2.0 scientific baseline unchanged.
